faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Andhra Pradesh Project Associate-1/RA/SRF/JRF/TA recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 18th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE/B.Tech degree in Computer Science and Engineering or Electronics and Communication Engineering or its relevant specialization to be eligible for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-1/RA/SRF/JRF/TA position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 25,000/- plus HRA. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all required details and documents and send it to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an interview, which can be conducted either online or offline, depending on the institute's decision and circumstances.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Associate-1/RA/SRF/JRF/TA post announced by NIT Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Associate-1/RA/SRF/JRF/TA is on a contractual basis. The duration of the contract will be as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIT Andhra Pradesh located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Andhra Pradesh is located in Tadepalligudem, Andhra Pradesh, with the pincode 534101.

faq.question: Q10. Can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: Yes, the official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.
